== Acquisition ==
This skill is given to all players in a [[Dwayna Vs Grenth]] match, as well as in [[Wintersday]] quests.

== Related skills ==
* {{skill icon|Advanced Snowball}}
* {{skill icon|Candy Corn Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Jack Frost}}

== Notes ==
* This skill is only available to players during Wintersday events.
* The projectile from this skill deals [[Armor-ignoring damage|armor-ignoring]] [[fire damage]].
* [[NPC]]s in towns that get redecorated for the Wintersday event get a [[Snowball (NPC)|non-damaging variant]].
* This skill is used by [[Grentch (summon)|Grentch]] and [[Snowman (summon)|Snowman]] from summoning stones and various Snowmen in the [[Secret Lair of the Snowmen]].
* This skill is also used by [[Snowman]] in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]]. They are friendly and only throw them on foes walking in the area.
